headline: Beijing hits back at Anthropic CEO's call to curb China's AI development
context: China's Foreign Ministry called the Anthropic CEO's warning about the dangers of Chinese-developed AI "fearmongering," as the Chinese and U.S. leaders prepare to meet in Washington later this month.

sources.name: NPR
